Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.2: Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading: Poem

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading: Poem, part of Strand 8 in Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: when giving an opinion. 1. How can one tell the meaning of unfamiliar words used in a text?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.
